otj.text: Tarnation is the hidden town the Hellspurs build around the legendary vault Maag Taranau, hoping Akul can control it.

When the infiltration team enters and sees Hellspurs duel openly, Twist Fandango and Akul's inner circle capture Oko, Kellan, Annie and Vraska, and Akul takes the sixth key from Oko and assembles the full key in his medallion.

Kellan challenges Akul to a duel that Akul declares a fight to the death, and Kellan lulls the dragon into a trance, but guilt breaks the spell and Akul pins him just as the Sterling Company army attacks Tarnation and interrupts the duel.

Tinybones frees the crew and Vraska petrifies the Hellspurs guarding them, Kellan tosses Akul's fallen medallion to Oko, and Oko admits he leaked Tarnation's coordinates to use the raid as a distraction and then leaves Kellan behind.
